details.aboutText: MaxWallet is a non-custodial cryptocurrency wallet designed to offer users seamless management of their digital assets.
MaxProfit is an educational platform tailored for individuals interested in cryptocurrency trading and investment.
MaxSwap is a crypto wallet with built-in virtual cards, allowing users to store, manage, and spend their digital assets with ease.

items.text: We had an idea, but we didn't have a team. MaxDev not only created our MVP but also helped us formulate the concept, prioritize features, and launch quickly. The team is engaged, communicative, and highly skilled.
items.author: Omar T.

items.text: We were looking for a team that could launch an MVP in three months, not a year. MaxDev delivered in 10 weeks. Clear sprints, minimal bureaucracy, and a focus on what the user really needed. An ideal partner for the early stages.
items.author: Alex R.

items.text: We needed more than just functionality, but a 'wow' effect for investors. MaxDev's designers completely redesigned our user flow. The app is intuitive and visually appealing. After the release, conversion rates increased by 40%.
items.author: Sarah J.

items.text: It's rare to find contractors who write such clean code." We needed a complex backend solution for a crypto exchange, and these guys offered an easily scalable architecture. No legacy code, everything is up to modern standards.
